summary: Pro tier deep decompilation, liquidity drain stress-testing, and privileged access audit for Chainlink Aggregator V3.

findings.title: Stale Price Feed & Negative Price Validation Trap
findings.description: Consuming latestRoundData() without verifying answer > 0, updatedAt > 0, and answeredInRound >= roundId.

attackSurface.attackVector: Oracle freezes or crashes during extreme liquidation event; downstream lending protocol consumes stale price.

remediation.recommendedAction: Apply verified check-effects-interactions, enforce timelocks, and guard critical state variables.
